name: terminal
description: Terminal-Bench-style shell tasks in a fresh workspace, judged by shell oracles over the files left behind

tasks.task: Create a file named hello.txt in the workspace containing exactly the text 'hello, world' (no trailing newline is fine). Then answer with FINAL over one row with column done = true.
The workspace has a file data.txt. How many lines does it have? Answer with FINAL over one row with column lines (an integer).
Rename every .log file in the workspace to .txt (same base name). Then answer with FINAL over one row with column renamed = the number of files renamed.

verify.command: test -f a.txt && test -f b.txt && test -f c.txt && ! ls *.log 2>/dev/null && test -f keep.md

tasks.task: Count how many lines in notes.md mention the word TODO (case-insensitive). Answer with FINAL over one row with column todos (an integer).
The workspace has sales.csv with a header row and columns region,amount. What is the total of the amount column? Answer with FINAL over one row with column total.
Write a file config.json in the workspace containing a JSON object with keys name (value "kleene") and version (value 7). Answer with FINAL over one row with column done = true.

verify.command: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('config.json')); sys.exit(0 if d.get('name')=='kleene' and d.get('version')==7 else 1)"
